artifact: SafeLoop v0.2 RC1 certified Hermes reference adapter
why_vendored: The Hermes working repository is local-only and is not pushed upstream, so a certification that referenced only its commit hash would not be reproducible by a reviewer. The exact certified adapter source is vendored here with checksums so the evidence stands on its own.
verify: sha256sum docs/evidence/hermes-adapter/* — compare against the values above, and against plugins/safeloop_guard/ in a Hermes checkout at the recorded commit or tag.
note: The local commit hash is recorded for provenance but is NOT the reproducibility mechanism; the vendored source and its checksums are.
